title: Brokkr tool dialect v1
description: One file under dialects/tools/ that makes one abstract capability concrete (decision 0065 ruling 2). A tool dialect says which capability it serves and binds it to exactly one implementation kind: provider-native, a capability a harness already has, addressed through that provider's adapter; mcp, an MCP server and the named tools on it; or hands, reserved for decision 0043's workspace tool, which does not move. A dialect grants nothing: only a realm's capabilities map selects one (ruling 3). The capability's reads/writes/egress classes belong to the operator's abstract definition under capabilities/; a dialect's classes, when written, assert equality with that definition and never supply or override it. The dialect's egress class is decision 0036's separate vocabulary and absent reads uncontracted. Validating a dialect executes nothing and contacts nothing.

name.description: The dialect's identity, equal to its file's stem.

serves.description: The abstract capability this dialect makes concrete.

tools.description: The named concrete tools that realise the capability.

classes.description: An equality assertion against the operator's abstract definition; never its source.

egress.description: Decision 0036's class for where this dialect's traffic goes. Absent reads uncontracted.

sends.description: What this dialect discloses: a fetch of a named URL and a free-text query a model composes are different disclosures.

restrictions.description: An embedded draft-07 object schema for a grant's restriction keys — every grant key other than dialect, tools and offices, which this schema may not redefine. It references nothing outside itself. Absent admits no restriction key.

provider.description: The adapter whose harness already has this capability.

adapter_key.description: The entry of that adapter's native_capabilities saying how the capability is switched on and off.

connection.description: Exactly one connection form: a stdio launch, or a server URL. Neither carries a credential: a secret is named under secrets and reaches the server as decision 0012 rules.

secrets.description: Decision 0012 binding names this server needs; never values. Empty when it needs none.

retained.description: Whether each response is kept as a content-addressed artifact (ruling 8). Declared here; built by a later slice.
